title: Shots response
description: Wire contract of the served shot detector (SPEC 8.10.3): the JSON body that a backend returns with status 200 from POST /shots. Last changed in spec version 0.103.0. The ingesting side validates every cut itself (SPEC 8.10.3, 8.10.4) and does not rely on this schema alone.

detector.description: Detector identity (SPEC 8.10.6): part of the shot identity stored with the shots.

cuts.description: The times, in seconds from the start of the media, at which a new shot starts. Order and repeats do not matter: the ingesting side sorts them, removes repeats, drops a cut at or before 0 or at or after the media duration, and applies the minimum shot length (SPEC 8.10.4). An empty array means the whole video is one shot.
